item.title: github: Copilot budget increase requests are generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot now supports a request flow for users who have exhausted their AI credits, allowing them to ask for a budget increase instead of being fully blocked from credit-consuming features. The feature is now generally available.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Per-model token breakdown in the usage report
item.description:
GitHub’s usage report now includes a per-model breakdown of tokens behind AI credits. The report shows token details for each model, including input, output, and cache usage.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: AI credit pools for cost centers in the billing UI
item.description:
GitHub Billing UI now lets you manage a cost center’s AI credit pool directly when creating or editing cost centers. Before this change, that configuration was only available through another interface.

  • Source: GitHub
